page_title: GET 1-2 CEL | Getafe v Celta Vigo 24/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+7' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
90+3' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90+1' Claudio Giraldez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) replacing Ilaix Moriba.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' It‘s a RED card, and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Juan Martinez had no choice but to send Domingos Duarte (Getafe) off. VAR seen to good effect there!
89' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Domingos Duarte (Getafe)! Let's see what he decides.
87' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Domingos Duarte (Getafe) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
85' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
85' Ismael Bekhoucha (Getafe) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
84' We are about to witness a substitution. Coba da Costa (Getafe) is replacing Christantus Uche.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Iago Aspas departs the field of play to be replaced by Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo).
84' Today's match ends for Oscar Mingueza who will be replaced by Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo).
81' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.

80' 1 - 2 Williot Swedberg sends a lovely ball into Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo). He latches on to it and shoots into the bottom right corner from the edge of the box. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:2.
80' Celta Vigo take a short corner kick.
79' Diego Rico (Getafe) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
79' Here comes a substitution. Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) is brought on as a substitute for Borja Mayoral.
76' Diego Rico (Getafe) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
75' The free kick from close range, taken by Celta Vigo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
75' It looks like Juanmi (Getafe) saw red with that tackle. Juan Martinez won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Celta Vigo are awarded a free kick.
73' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Borja Iglesias and he is replaced by Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo).
73' That will be all from Alfonso Gonzalez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
71' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
69' A corner kick by Celta Vigo is thwarted by the well prepared David Soria (Getafe).
69' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Now Celta Vigo have a corner.
68' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to David Soria, who smothers the ball.
66' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
64' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Celta Vigo.
64' Celta Vigo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Celta Vigo force their opponents to concede a corner.
61' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) receives a short pass and produces a low effort from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a routine save.
59' The referee allows time for a substitution. Mauro Arambarri will be replaced by Ismael Bekhoucha (Getafe).
59' Jose Bordalas Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Ramon Terrats will be replaced by Juanmi (Getafe).
59' What a chance that is! Iago Aspas swings the ball into the box, and Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) gets in front of his man and powers his header just over the bar.
59' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Celta Vigo.

58' That was a nice football moment. Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom right corner. David Soria guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! The referee points to the corner flag and Celta Vigo will take a corner.
57' Yellu Santiago (Getafe) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
57' The ball goes out for a corner. Getafe can continue in their attacking effort.
56' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) anticipates the cross from Marcos Alonso, but powers his header way over the bar from the edge of the six-yard box.
55' Borja Iglesias nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
54' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Celta Vigo, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
53' Diego Rico (Getafe) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
53' Diego Rico (Getafe) is penalised for holding. Juan Martinez signals a set piece.
51' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Christantus Uche (Getafe) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Half-chance! Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) plays a pass into the box, but David Soria reacts well to snuff out the attack.
50' Christantus Uche (Getafe) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
49' The attendance is 12862.
47' Christantus Uche (Getafe) commits a rough challenge and Juan Martinez blows his whistle for an infringement.
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Yellu Santiago (Getafe) comes on the pitch for Juan Berrocal Gonzalez.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+7' Ramon Terrats (Getafe) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

45+5' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his shot flies just over the crossbar. This should be a big warning for the defence.
45+5' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

45+5' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Celta Vigo force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
45+3' Rough tackle by Djene (Getafe). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
45' Getafe seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
39' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY, play can continue.

38' Play continues despite the shouts by some Celta Vigo players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Juan Martinez interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
35' David Soria displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
33' Getafe couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Vicente Guaita (Celta Vigo) leaped high and intercepted the cross.

33' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Juan Martinez with no other option than to blow for a foul.
33' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) offside.
31' The possession of the ball – 29:71.
26' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
25' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Iago Aspas laid the ball off to Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo), who shot from close range into the right side of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
18' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) but poses no threat.
17' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Juan Martinez blows for a foul.

17' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Celta Vigo are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
11' 1 - 0 Goal! Great play by Christantus Uche releases Borja Mayoral (Getafe) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom left corner. 1:0.
10' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
9' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) brings an opponent down and Juan Martinez interrupts the game.
7' Juan Berrocal Gonzalez (Getafe) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
6' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
3' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) makes a strong challenge and Juan Martinez blows for a foul.
1' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but David Soria is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Celta Vigo will take the kick-off.
Juan Martinez is the one to supervise the game today.
